references.text: The prophet Isaiah uses the image of one who sifts grain to describe God's judgment and purification.
Micah speaks about God's judgment and purification in a similar way as in Matthew.
Jeremiah also uses the image of sifting grain as a metaphor for God's judgment.
Jesus uses the parable of the wheat and the tares to illustrate the separation between the righteous and the wicked at the end of the age.
